old_caption: The video captures a curious cat observing a large plastic bag filled with water and a koi fish on a tiled surface. The bag has some water droplets on it, likely from condensation or the water inside. The cat, with a fluffy coat of brown and white fur, sits on all fours, leaning forward to get a closer look at the fish. Its ears are perked up, indicating interest or curiosity. The background shows a gray tiled surface and part of a black table leg, suggesting the scene takes place outdoors. The lighting is natural and diffuse, with no harsh shadows visible. The cat's attention remains fixed on the fish throughout the sequence, showing no signs of distraction.
original_wisa_caption: The video captures a curious cat observing a large, wrapped object on a tiled surface. The object is encased in clear plastic wrap, which has some water droplets on it, suggesting it might have been recently washed or is damp. The cat, with a fluffy coat of brown and white fur, stands on its hind legs, leaning forward to get a closer look at the object. Its ears are perked up, indicating interest or curiosity. The background shows a gray tiled floor and part of a black chair leg, hinting that the scene takes place indoors, possibly on a patio or balcony. The lighting is natural, likely from an overcast sky, as there are no harsh shadows visible. The cat's attention remains fixed on the wrapped object throughout the sequence, showing no signs of distraction.
caption: The video captures a clear plastic bag of water holding a single white-and-red koi fish on a gray tiled tabletop, its left end gathered and tied with an orange band. Condensation droplets and a yellowish water layer coat the plastic. A long-haired brown-and-white cat sits at the right edge, its muzzle pressed against the bag's pointed tip where the fish's head lies. The cat then lifts its head away from the plastic, reorienting its face from a downward sniff toward the camera. It shifts its seated body slightly, drawing its paws and torso back until it settles upright, gazing down at the bag. Meanwhile the camera reframes outward, sliding the tied left end of the bag out of view and revealing a terracotta pot and white pebbles along the top. The koi stays largely fixed inside the bag, its apparent displacement dominated by the changing frame rather than visible swimming.
